activity.notes: Senwosret III was a Twelfth Dynasty pharaoh of Egypt. ATLAS follows the Metropolitan Museum chronology of approximately 1878–1840 BCE and preserves the chronological boundaries as approximate.

sources.title: The Pyramid Complex of Senwosret III, Dahshur — The Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum identifies Senwosret III as one of the most powerful rulers of ancient Egypt and dates his reign to approximately 1878–1840 BCE.
